description: One campground: whether it is open today, the season, how to book it (Recreation.gov or the concessioner, or first come first served), fees, rules, its official page, and a model weather forecast. Accepts an id (e.g. "upper-pines") or a name. NPS campgrounds follow the park's published schedule; Forest Service ones show the listed status (refreshed every 6 hours). California State Parks camping areas are from its official GIS catalog, which supplies no opening status. "not listed" means unknown, not closed. California State Parks attribution is required; commercial GIS use requires permission (https://www.parks.ca.gov/?page_id=29682).
name: campgrounds_get_status
title: Get campground status
